 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Kings are coming off a 3-0 win over the Boston Bruins, in which Darcy Kuemper recorded his 40th career shutout. The Kings are looking for their 2nd straight win against a Leafs team that has lost 9 of its last 10. Despite the Leafs' struggles, the Kings will have to play as they did against Boston to leave Toronto with a win.

 Game Notes
 The Kings will be without Artemi Panarin for the 3rd straight game due to personal reasons. The Kings have also scratched Cody Ceci and will be without Trevor Moore due to an undisclosed injury. The Leafs have scratched Cole McWard, Brendan Brisson, and Dakota Mermis for tonight's game, and they will be without Max Domi (undisclosed), Kirill Marchenko (lower body), Marshall Rifai (lower body), Nick Blankenburg (upper body), and Colton Sissons (lower body).
 Tonight's starting goaltenders are Darcy Kuemper for the Kings and Anthony Stolarz for the Leafs. Kuemper is coming off a 3-0 win against Boston, and Stolarz is coming off a 1-0 loss against the Edmonton Oilers.
 Kings are set to take on the Leafs tonight at 7 PM ET.
